Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description: Represents a planned tour itinerary designed by an administrator, containing a sequence of points of interest and route information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Trip entity.

name.description: The display name of the trip, as defined by the administrator.

description.description: A detailed overview or summary of the trip.

startLatitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the trip's starting point.

startLongitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the trip's starting point.

endLatitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the trip's intended ending point.

endLongitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the trip's intended ending point.

estimatedTotalDurationMinutes.description: The total estimated duration of the entire trip in minutes, including travel and visit times.

estimatedTotalDistanceKilometers.description: The total estimated driving distance of the entire trip in kilometers.

routePolyline.description: An encoded polyline string representing the entire recommended driving route for the trip.

adminId.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the administrator who created or last modified this trip. (Relationship: AdminUser 1:N Trip)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the trip record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the trip record was last updated.

PointOfInterest.title: PointOfInterest
PointOfInterest.description: Represents a specific location or landmark that can be included in one or more trips, containing rich content and geographical data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PointOfInterest entity.

name.description: The common name of the point of interest.

description.description: A detailed description providing information about the point of interest.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the point of interest.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the point of interest.

address.description: The human-readable street address of the point of interest.

type.description: A category or type classification for the POI (e.g., 'historical site', 'museum', 'natural landmark').

suggestedVisitDurationMinutes.description: The recommended amount of time a user should spend visiting this point of interest, in minutes.

defaultNarrationText.description: The default text to be used as a base for AI-generated audio narration for this POI.

defaultNarrationStyle.description: The default preferred narration style for AI-generated audio for this POI (e.g., 'adventure', 'calm', 'historical').

threeDModelAssetId.description: Reference to a ThreeDModelAsset for immersive 3D previews of this POI. (Relationship: PointOfInterest 1:1 ThreeDModelAsset)

imageAssetIds.description: References to ImageAsset entities associated with this POI, for visual context. (Relationship: PointOfInterest N:N ImageAsset)

soundEffectAssetIds.description: References to SoundEffectAsset entities for ambient audio relevant to this POI. (Relationship: PointOfInterest N:N SoundEffectAsset)

adminId.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the administrator who created or last modified this POI. (Relationship: AdminUser 1:N PointOfInterest)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the POI record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the POI record was last updated.

TripPoi.title: TripPoi
TripPoi.description: A junction entity linking a specific PointOfInterest to a Trip, defining its sequential order and trip-specific details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TripPoi entity, representing a specific stop within a trip.

tripId.description: Reference to the Trip this POI belongs to. (Relationship: Trip 1:N TripPoi)

poiId.description: Reference to the PointOfInterest being visited at this stop. (Relationship: PointOfInterest 1:N TripPoi)

orderIndex.description: The sequential order of this POI within the trip, starting from 1.

adminId.description: Denormalized adminId from the parent Trip for secure, query-agnostic authorization.

customNarrationText.description: Optional override text for AI narration specific to this POI within this particular trip, if different from the POI's default.

customNarrationStyle.description: Optional override for the narration style for AI-generated audio for this specific POI within this trip.

estimatedTravelTimeFromPreviousMinutes.description: The estimated travel time in minutes from the previous stop (or trip start) to this point of interest.

estimatedTravelDistanceFromPreviousKilom.description: The estimated travel distance in kilometers from the previous stop (or trip start) to this point of interest.

segmentPolylineFromPrevious.description: An encoded polyline string representing the specific route segment from the previous stop (or trip start) to this point of interest.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the trip POI record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the trip POI record was last updated.

ImageAsset.title: ImageAsset
ImageAsset.description: Stores metadata and URLs for images used to enrich points of interest or trip descriptions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ImageAsset entity.

name.description: A descriptive name for the image asset.

url.description: The URL where the full-resolution image file can be accessed.

thumbnailUrl.description: The URL where a smaller thumbnail version of the image file can be accessed.

altText.description: Alternative text for the image, used for accessibility purposes.

storagePath.description: The internal storage path or identifier for caching the asset for offline use.

adminId.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the administrator who uploaded this image asset. (Relationship: AdminUser 1:N ImageAsset)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the image asset record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the image asset record was last updated.

NarrationAsset.title: NarrationAsset
NarrationAsset.description: Stores details about pre-generated or cached AI narration audio files, including the source text and audio file location.

id.description: Unique identifier for the NarrationAsset entity.

sourceText.description: The original text content that was used to generate this narration audio.

language.description: The language code of the narration (e.g., 'en-US', 'es-ES').

narrationStyle.description: The stylistic choice used for the narration (e.g., 'adventure', 'calm', 'historical').

audioUrl.description: The URL where the generated audio file can be accessed.

durationSeconds.description: The duration of the audio narration in seconds.

storagePath.description: The internal storage path or identifier for caching the narration audio for offline use.

adminId.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the administrator who initiated the creation/upload of this narration asset. (Relationship: AdminUser 1:N NarrationAsset)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the narration asset record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the narration asset record was last updated.

ThreeDModelAsset.title: ThreeDModelAsset
ThreeDModelAsset.description: Stores metadata and URLs for 3D GLTF models used for immersive landmark previews.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ThreeDModelAsset entity.

name.description: A descriptive name for the 3D model asset.

modelUrl.description: The URL where the GLTF model bundle (.gltf or .glb) can be accessed.

thumbnailUrl.description: The URL where a preview image for the 3D model can be accessed.

description.description: A brief description of the 3D model's content or purpose.

storagePath.description: The internal storage path or identifier for caching the 3D model for offline use.

adminId.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the administrator who uploaded this 3D model asset. (Relationship: AdminUser 1:N ThreeDModelAsset)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the 3D model asset record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the 3D model asset record was last updated.

SoundEffectAsset.title: SoundEffectAsset
SoundEffectAsset.description: Stores details about sound effect audio files used to create an adaptive audio experience during tours.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SoundEffectAsset entity.

name.description: A descriptive name for the sound effect asset.

description.description: A description of what the sound effect represents (e.g., 'forest birds', 'city ambiance').

audioUrl.description: The URL where the sound effect audio file can be accessed.

durationSeconds.description: The duration of the sound effect audio in seconds.

storagePath.description: The internal storage path or identifier for caching the sound effect for offline use.

adminId.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the administrator who uploaded this sound effect asset. (Relationship: AdminUser 1:N SoundEffectAsset)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the sound effect asset record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the sound effect asset record was last updated.

definition.description: Top-level collection for Trip entities. Access is controlled by the 'adminId' field within each document.
Subcollection for TripPoi entities. Each document includes 'adminId' for secure listing.

params.name: tripId
params.description: Unique identifier of the parent Trip.

firestore.reasoning: Standardized ownership model with 'adminId' present in all primary and subcollection documents to satisfy Query-Agnostic Rules (QAPs) without cross-document lookups.
